title: A Deep Learning Approach for the Identification of the Molecular Subtypes of Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Based on Whole Slide Pathology Images.
summary: Deep-learning models classify PurIST molecular subtypes from H&E whole-slide and biopsy images. TCGA patient-level concordance 83.03%±6.35%, AUC .867; external frozen needle biopsy cohort reports PPV 1.0 and NPV .85. This supports feasibility, not replacement of molecular testing or clinical benefit. TCGA training/validation plus separate POG-PANGEN external biopsy cohort; small retrospective translational sample. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
